title: ForkCast
description: Smart fridge and meal recommendation app. Ranks fridge items by expiry date and priority so food gets used before it spoils.

title: WordBlaster
description: 2D typing game: type the words on falling bombs to destroy them. Waves get harder over time, with saved high scores, music and sound effects.

title: Gesture-Controlled RC Car
description: A car driven by hand tilts: a wearable ESP32 with an MPU6050 sends low-latency commands over ESP-NOW, plus a Wi-Fi access point for driving from a phone browser.

title: University Management System
description: Role-based portals for admins, department heads, faculty and students to manage courses, enrolment and grades.

title: Bank Management System
description: One login routes users to role-based dashboards: managers handle accounts and staff, cashiers handle deposits and transfers, customers view accounts and send funds.

title: Arduino Temperature Clock
description: Breadboard device showing time, date and room temperature, with a built-in stopwatch and timer.

title: NoteApp
description: Desktop app to create, edit, search and save notes.
